Q: Spring Boot returns 403 instead of 405 when sending GET to POST-only endpoint A:

I don't think that /api/v1/products matches /api/v1/products/** you might need to do

.requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/api/v1/products", "/api/v1/products/**").permitAll()

Q: No test result files matching **/test-*.xml were found - Azure DevOps A:

I had the same issue keep trying to understand where come from the issue.

In the end I configured the package.json with 2 scripts:

"scripts": {
    "test:e2e": "playwright test",
    "test:e2e:ci": "playwright test --reporter=html"
  },

the thing is that in my azure-pipelines.yml I was calling the script

- script: |
    npm run test:e2e:ci
  displayName: 'Run Playwright tests'
  env:
    CI: true

as

npm run test:e2e:ci

is flagged with --reporter=html

that was overwritting the playwright.config.ts

reporter: [
    ['list'],
    ['junit', { outputFile: 'test-results/junit-results.xml' }],
    ['html', { open: 'never' }]
  ],

So in the end I just called test:e2e instead of test:e2e:ci in the azure-pipelines.yml file and that is now working

- script: |
    npm run test:e2e
  displayName: 'Run Playwright tests'
  env:
    CI: true
